name: Three-Arm Eval (issue #171)
description: Canonical three-arm bench — baseline / terse / lazy_skill / <user-skill>. Mirrors ponytail's benchmarks/README.md:34-58 (LOC, USD, latency, correctness). Two cases are LOC-countable (deterministic), one needs an LLM judge (best-quality variant).

test_cases.prompt: Explain what Goroutines are in two sentences.
test_cases.description: LOC-countable answer. The terse arm should produce ≤ 2 lines; the skill arm should produce ≥ 2 but provide citations.

test_cases.prompt: Write a Go function that reverses a UTF-8 string without allocating a new buffer.
test_cases.description: LOC-countable code generation. Honest delta vs terse should be measurable.

test_cases.prompt: Compare the loss characteristics of LZ4 vs zstd for cold-storage workloads (3 sentences max).
test_cases.description: LLM-judge case. Pass-rate flips on judged quality, not just keyword match.

expected.custom_criteria: Correctness: explicit ratio or qualitative comparison; Honesty: no hallucinated benchmark numbers; Brevity: ≤ 3 sentences.
